ownerInstruction: I want you to answer every single question for every single person. Not every single question needs independent research. Do your best. Do them on mass. Do them to the best of your ability. I will personally review your work afterwards.
method: Existing historical numerical proposals are treated as candidates, not target scores. Supported corrections are retained. Missing responses are provisionally reassessed from the candidate rationale and subject-specific axis evidence, with reduced strength and explicit inference limits. A distinct substantive self-review and targeted overrides follow. Source records from prior research remain attributed to their original access dates. No independent-source-per-question requirement is imposed under the owner’s instruction.
